```{r}

# WORLD INCOME INEQUALITY EXPLORER
# Combining World Bank WDI and OECD data

# PART 1: Load packages

library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(tidyverse)
library(WDI)
library(countrycode)


# PART 2: Download World Bank Gini data

wdi_data <- WDI(
  country = "all",
  indicator = "SI.POV.GINI",
  start = 2010,
  end = 2024
) %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    iso3c,
    year = as.integer(year),
    Gini = as.numeric(SI.POV.GINI)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(iso3c),
    !is.na(Gini),
    Gini >= 0,
    Gini <= 100
  ) %>%
  distinct(iso3c, year, .keep_all = TRUE)


# PART 3: Import your OECD CSV

# Find the OECD file in your project folder

oecd_files <- list.files(
  path = ".",
  pattern = "^OECD.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

if (length(oecd_files) == 0) {
  stop(
    "OECD CSV not found. Upload the OECD CSV ",
    "to your current RStudio project folder."
  )
}

oecd_raw <- read_csv(
  oecd_files[1],
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# PART 4: Clean the OECD data

# Use Gini for disposable income,
# total population, current definition,
# and annual observations.

oecd_data <- oecd_raw %>%
  filter(
    MEASURE == "INC_DISP_GINI",
    AGE == "_T",
    DEFINITION == "D_CUR",
    FREQ == "A"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(TIME_PERIOD),
    Gini = as.numeric(OBS_VALUE) * 100,
    iso3c = REF_AREA
  ) %>%
  filter(
    year >= 2010,
    year <= 2024,
    !is.na(Gini),
    Gini >= 0,
    Gini <= 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    iso3c,
    year,
    desc(METHODOLOGY == "METH2012")
  ) %>%
  distinct(iso3c, year, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  transmute(
    country = `Reference area`,
    iso3c,
    year,
    Gini
  )


# PART 5: Combine the datasets

# WDI gets priority.
# OECD fills missing country-year values.

graph_data <- full_join(
  wdi_data %>%
    rename(
      WDI_Gini = Gini,
      WDI_Country = country
    ),
  oecd_data %>%
    rename(
      OECD_Gini = Gini,
      OECD_Country = country
    ),
  by = c("iso3c", "year")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Gini = coalesce(WDI_Gini, OECD_Gini),

    country = coalesce(
      WDI_Country,
      OECD_Country
    ),

    Source = case_when(
      !is.na(WDI_Gini) ~ "WDI",
      !is.na(OECD_Gini) ~ "OECD",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

    Continent = countrycode(
      iso3c,
      "iso3c",
      "continent"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Gini),
    !is.na(Continent),
    !is.na(iso3c)
  ) %>%
  arrange(country, year)

# Check how many observations came from each source

print(table(graph_data$Source))

# Check the total number of countries

print(n_distinct(graph_data$iso3c))


# PART 6: Create the interactive interface

ui <- fluidPage(

  titlePanel(
    "World Income Inequality Explorer"
  ),

  p(
    "Explore income inequality across countries",
    "using World Bank and OECD data.",
    "Darker red indicates greater inequality."
  ),

  sidebarLayout(

    sidebarPanel(

      sliderInput(
        "year",
        "Select Year:",
        min = 2010,
        max = 2024,
        value = 2022,
        step = 1,
        sep = ""
      ),

      selectInput(
        "continent",
        "Select Continent:",
        choices = c(
          "All Continents",
          sort(unique(graph_data$Continent))
        )
      ),

      sliderInput(
        "gini_range",
        "Select Gini Coefficient Range:",
        min = 0,
        max = 100,
        value = c(0, 100)
      ),

      checkboxInput(
        "compare",
        "Compare Two Countries",
        value = FALSE
      ),

      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.compare == true",

        selectInput(
          "country1",
          "First Country:",
          choices = sort(unique(graph_data$country)),
          selected = "United States"
        ),

        selectInput(
          "country2",
          "Second Country:",
          choices = sort(unique(graph_data$country)),
          selected = "Canada"
        )
      ),

      actionButton(
        "reset",
        "Reset Filters"
      ),

      hr(),

      p(
        "Data sources:",
        "World Bank WDI and OECD."
      ),

      p(
        "Gray countries have no available",
        "Gini value for the selected year."
      )
    ),

    mainPanel(

      plotlyOutput(
        "world_map",
        height = "550px"
      ),

      h4(textOutput("country_count")),

      tableOutput("source_table"),

      conditionalPanel(
        condition = "input.compare == true",

        h3("Country Comparison Over Time"),

        plotlyOutput(
          "comparison_plot",
          height = "350px"
        )
      )
    )
  )
)


# PART 7: Create the Shiny server

server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # Apply the selected filters

  filtered_data <- reactive({

    data <- graph_data %>%
      filter(
        year == input$year,
        Gini >= input$gini_range[1],
        Gini <= input$gini_range[2]
      )

    if (input$continent != "All Continents") {
      data <- data %>%
        filter(Continent == input$continent)
    }

    data
  })


  # PART 8: Interactive world map

  output$world_map <- renderPlotly({

    map_data <- filtered_data()

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(map_data) > 0,
        "No countries match the selected filters."
      )
    )

    plot_ly(
      data = map_data,
      type = "choropleth",

      locations = ~iso3c,
      locationmode = "ISO-3",

      z = ~Gini,

      text = ~paste0(
        "Country: ", country,
        "<br>Continent: ", Continent,
        "<br>Year: ", year,
        "<br>Gini Coefficient: ",
        round(Gini, 1),
        "<br>Data Source: ", Source
      ),

      hoverinfo = "text",

      # WHITE = EQUALITY
      # DARK RED = HIGH INEQUALITY

      colorscale = list(
        c(0.00, "#FFFFFF"),
        c(0.25, "#FFE5E5"),
        c(0.50, "#FF7777"),
        c(0.75, "#CC2222"),
        c(1.00, "#660000")
      ),

      zmin = 0,
      zmax = 100,

      colorbar = list(
        title = "Gini Index",
        tickvals = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100)
      ),

      marker = list(
        line = list(
          color = "gray",
          width = 0.4
        )
      )
    ) %>%
      layout(

        title = paste(
          "Global Income Inequality:",
          input$year
        ),

        geo = list(
          showframe = FALSE,
          showcoastlines = TRUE,
          showland = TRUE,
          landcolor = "#E6E6E6",

          projection = list(
            type = "natural earth"
          )
        )
      )
  })


  # PART 9: Country count

  output$country_count <- renderText({

    paste(
      "Countries displayed:",
      n_distinct(filtered_data()$iso3c)
    )
  })


  # Show how many countries use each source

  output$source_table <- renderTable({

    filtered_data() %>%
      count(Source, name = "Countries") %>%
      arrange(desc(Countries))

  })


  # PART 10: Compare countries over time

  output$comparison_plot <- renderPlotly({

    req(input$compare)

    comparison_data <- graph_data %>%
      filter(
        country %in% c(
          input$country1,
          input$country2
        )
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Hover = paste0(
          "Country: ", country,
          "<br>Year: ", year,
          "<br>Gini: ", round(Gini, 1),
          "<br>Data Source: ", Source
        )
      )

    validate(
      need(
        nrow(comparison_data) > 0,
        "No comparison data available."
      )
    )

    p <- ggplot(
      comparison_data,
      aes(
        x = year,
        y = Gini,
        color = country,
        group = country,
        text = Hover
      )
    ) +
      geom_line() +
      geom_point(size = 2) +

      labs(
        title = "Income Inequality Over Time",
        x = "Year",
        y = "Gini Coefficient",
        color = "Country"
      ) +

      scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 100)
      ) +

      theme_minimal()

    ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")
  })


  # PART 11: Reset all filters

  observeEvent(input$reset, {

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "year",
      value = 2022
    )

    updateSelectInput(
      session,
      "continent",
      selected = "All Continents"
    )

    updateSliderInput(
      session,
      "gini_range",
      value = c(0, 100)
    )

    updateCheckboxInput(
      session,
      "compare",
      value = FALSE
    )
  })

}


# PART 12: Launch the app

shinyApp(ui, server)

```
